name: product-progress
prompt: Screen: Dashboard with the "Progress" tab active (amber underline). Above the tabs the status card "Working hours · Lines busy: 5 of 5". Under the tabs a dropdown "By segments" and a filter icon button. A vertical list of four wide segment panels. Each panel: segment name on the left and on the right a bold percentage with a muted note like "64% processed 1,152 of 1,800"; a wide horizontal progress bar with an amber fill for processed, a darker amber fill for in progress and a dark track for the rest; under the bar a legend with colored dots "Processed 1,152 · 64%", "In progress 540 · 30%", "Passed to manager 38 · 2%"; and a row "Ratings" with small chips "D 412", "C 388", "B 214", "A 138". Segments: "Food & beverage shippers" (64%), "Building materials" (41%), "Auto parts distributors" (27%), "Retail DCs — Canada" (52%). Render it as a crisp, pixel-perfect desktop web-app screenshot, flat and straight-on, with no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective and no watermark. Product: "MagnaQore Logistic", an AI calling and sales system for North American freight companies. Dark theme: page background deep warm charcoal #141311; panels and cards #1d1b18 with hairline borders #2c2925 and 12px rounded corners; primary text warm off-white #ece8e1; secondary text muted warm grey #8f8a82; one accent, amber-gold #e9a23b, used for the active navigation marker, count badges, primary buttons, progress fills, active tabs and toggles; green #3fae7a only for positive statuses; lead ratings shown as small rounded chips reading A, B, C or D. Typography: a clean geometric sans-serif similar to Manrope, calm spacing, 13–15px interface text that is sharp, legible and spelled correctly. Left sidebar about 230px wide: a small muted label "MagnaQore" above the bold product name "Logistic AI" with a bell icon; navigation with thin line icons in this order: Dashboard (small amber count badge), Contacts, Dialer, Calls, Chats, Lead gen, Assistant, Settings, Help, System; at the bottom a user block "Alex Morgan" with the role "Sales ops" and a log-out icon. All people, companies, phone numbers and figures are fictional; phone numbers use the US 555 range. English only.
